channel.title: Lotus Sun Energy: Solar Guides for India
channel.description: Plain-English guides to solar in India: the PM Surya Ghar subsidy, net metering, GST, ALMM, batteries, CAPEX vs OPEX, installation and maintenance, from a veteran-led solar company.

item.title: Solar Import Duty in India (2026): Customs on Modules and Cells, and What Budget 2026-27 Changed
item.description: Customs duty on imported solar modules and cells in 2026: BCD at 20% plus AIDC, Budget 2026-27 changes, anti-dumping and what buyers should do.

item.title: Accelerated Depreciation on Solar in India: How a Business Recovers the Cost Faster
item.description: A business that owns its solar plant can claim 40% depreciation on written-down value. How it works under the Income-tax Act, 2025, with an example.

item.title: Green Energy Open Access in India: Buy Solar Power from Off-Site Plants from 100 kW
item.description: Green Energy Open Access lets consumers from 100 kW buy solar from off-site plants. Eligibility, charges, banking, GOAR and the ISTS waiver phase-out.

item.title: Solar Quality and Safety Norms in India (2026): BIS, the Quality Control Order, CEA and CEIG
item.description: Quality and safety norms for solar plants in India in 2026: the BIS Quality Control Order, key IS/IEC standards for each part and CEIG approval.

item.title: Battery Storage with Solar in India (2026): Mandates, Incentives and When It Pays
item.description: Battery storage with solar in India: the 2-hour storage rule in tenders, VGF for BESS, ISTS waiver terms, the draft 500 kW rule and when it pays.

item.title: Solar Plant Installation and Commissioning: The Complete Step-by-Step Checklist
item.description: Step by step through installing and commissioning a solar plant in India: civil works, structures, modules, cabling, earthing, tests and handover.

item.title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana 2026: Subsidy, Eligibility and How to Apply
item.description: PM Surya Ghar gives homes up to Rs 78,000 for rooftop solar. Subsidy by size, housing-society support, loans, eligibility and how to apply in 2026.

item.title: India's Solar Capacity in 2026: 171 GW and What It Means for Your Business

item.title: GST on Solar in India (2026): 5% on Equipment, About 8.9% on EPC Contracts
item.description: GST on solar modules is 5% since 22 September 2025. How the 70:30 rule puts EPC contracts near 8.9%, input tax credit and a worked example.

item.title: ALMM List-I and List-II Explained: The Made-in-India Rule for Solar Modules and Cells

item.title: CAPEX vs OPEX (RESCO) Solar: Which Model Suits Your Business?
